## Chemistry table (fadePerEFC = 20/cycleLife, enforced)
- LFP: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) | cycleLife 4000 | fade 0.005%/EFC | calendar 1.1%/yr | Ea 28kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.55 | curve flat
- NMC622: NMC 622 | cycleLife 1800 | fade 0.0111%/EFC | calendar 1.6%/yr | Ea 38kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1 | curve sloped
- NMC811: NMC 811 (high-Ni) | cycleLife 1500 | fade 0.0133%/EFC | calendar 1.9%/yr | Ea 42kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.15 | curve sloped
- NCA: NCA (Tesla/Panasonic) | cycleLife 1600 | fade 0.0125%/EFC | calendar 1.8%/yr | Ea 40kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.05 | curve sloped
- LMO: LMO / NMC-LMO blend (Leaf, eC3) | cycleLife 1200 | fade 0.0167%/EFC | calendar 2.2%/yr | Ea 35kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.9 | curve dual-slope
- LMFP: LMFP (next-gen LFP+Mn) | cycleLife 3000 | fade 0.0067%/EFC | calendar 1.25%/yr | Ea 30kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.65 | curve stepped-flat
- SODIUM: Sodium-ion (Na-ion) | cycleLife 2500 | fade 0.008%/EFC | calendar 1.3%/yr | Ea 26kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.5 | curve sloped
- LTO: LTO (Toshiba SCiB, some buses) | cycleLife 12000 | fade 0.0017%/EFC | calendar 0.5%/yr | Ea 22kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.25 | curve flat
- NMC9-SI: NMC 9-series + Si anode (2025+ high-density) | cycleLife 1300 | fade 0.0154%/EFC | calendar 2%/yr | Ea 43kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1.2 | curve sloped
- SEMISOLID: Semi-solid / condensed-matter (NIO/Toyota class) | cycleLife 1600 | fade 0.0125%/EFC | calendar 1.7%/yr | Ea 39kJ/mol | fastPenalty 1 | curve sloped
- SODIUM-G2: Sodium-ion Gen2 (CATL Naxtra class) | cycleLife 3000 | fade 0.0067%/EFC | calendar 1.15%/yr | Ea 25kJ/mol | fastPenalty 0.45 | curve sloped

## Validation residuals (model vs AVILOO medians, Berlin, 20% DC, 70% SoC)
- vw-id4: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 95.3% (r=-0.8); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 90.6% (r=-1.7)
- tesla-my: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 94.4% (r=0.1); @150k model 89% vs aviloo 90.3% (r=-1.3)
- tesla-m3: @50k model 96.6% vs aviloo 93.8% (r=2.8); @150k model 93.3% vs aviloo 91.5% (r=1.8)
- ioniq5: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 97.1% (r=-2.6); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 93% (r=-4.1)
- leaf40: @50k model 92.6% vs aviloo 91.2% (r=1.4); @150k model 84.6% vs aviloo 86.7% (r=-2.1)
- zoe52: @50k model 95.1% vs aviloo 91.6% (r=3.5); @150k model 90% vs aviloo 90.1% (r=-0.1)
- mach-e: @50k model 94.5% vs aviloo 95.1% (r=-0.6); @150k model 88.9% vs aviloo 90.4% (r=-1.5)
- polestar2: @50k model 94.6% vs aviloo 95% (r=-0.4); @150k model 89% vs aviloo 90.8% (r=-1.8)
- Summary: mean |residual| @50k = 1.5 pts; @150k = 1.8 pts (v2026.12 was ~2.4 @50k and −15.0 worst-case @150k). Worst misses, published not hidden: ioniq5 −4.1 @150k (heat-pump E-GMP long-soak under-modelled) and zoe52 +3.5 @50k (small-pack rental-fleet abuse in AVILOO sample exceeds 20%-DC assumption). Model 3 AVILOO median mixes LFP+NMC trims; ours is LFP-only (+2.8 @50k). Geotab Jan-2026 cross-check (22,700 EVs): fleet 2.3%/yr; model yr-1..4 perYr 2.0–2.6%/yr, flattening after — consistent.

## EU DPP pre-map (EU 2023/1542 Annex XIII + Aug-2026 Guidance (71 pts), mandatory 2027-02-18)
- [mapped] 1(a) battery ID + model/batch/serial ← model.id + VIN-hash + timestamp
- [mapped] 1(g) rated capacity Ah + kWh ← model.kwh + chemistry nominalV
- [mapped] 1(k) exhaustion threshold + basis (EV only, no universal 80%) ← warranty.soh trigger + clause text
- [partial] 1(o) internal resistance ← OBD cell delta-V proxy (mapped when OBD present, else estimated)
- [mapped] 1(p) C-rate of cycle-life test ← fastPct + fastPenalty + ultra flag
- [operator-attach] 2(a-c) carbon footprint + method + PEF link ← BNEF anchor + route note (operator to attach PEF study)
- [mapped] 2(d) safety measures ← thermalSafeC + service + checklist
- [mapped] 3 test reports (compliance) ← method + SHA-256 evidence PDF hash
- [mapped] SoH + cycles + durability (performance class) ← soh ±CI + EFC + cyclesLeft + trajectory
